title: StateManager (masterSeed uint64 round-trip, Re-roll seed generation, A/B slots) and PluginEditor skeleton with Re-roll button stub
description:
Implement state serialization with masterSeed reproducibility and a minimal editor shell including Re-roll.

Before editing, inspect:
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/Source/StateManager.h/.cpp (A/B slots, parameterLayoutVersion, comparison XML)
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp (Timer, ResizableCornerComponent patterns)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h from a.3 (APVTS accessors, createEditor signature)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h (masterSeed property name, parameterLayoutVersion)
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §§4.10, 5 non-params, 9.1 header Re-roll

Implement:
1. Source/StateManager.h/.cpp:
   - A/B slot capture/apply/switch/copy/reset parallel to shred-width
   - createComparisonState/restoreComparisonState and XML helpers including parameterLayoutVersion
   - masterSeed uint64 stored on the value tree (and in slot snapshots): getMasterSeed/setMasterSeed; getState/setState paths used by processor must round-trip the exact uint64
   - reRollMasterSeed(): generate new seed via splitmix64(std::random_device entropy) on the message thread; write masterSeed; mark state dirty so host save picks it up; do NOT call std::random_device on the audio thread
   - include tiny splitmix64 helper (local static/free function) if not already present
2. Wire PluginProcessor getStateInformation/setStateInformation through StateManager if not already complete in a.3—only touch Processor if absolutely required; prefer StateManager completeness + editor calling processor APIs. If Processor must be updated for compile, note that a.3 owns Processor: implement StateManager API so a.3's existing stubs can call it without further Processor edits when possible. When createEditor needs Signature from Processor, implement PluginEditor only.
3. Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp skeleton:
   - ShredDoubleAudioProcessorEditor : public juce::AudioProcessorEditor, private juce::Timer
   - constructor takes processor ref; setSize reasonable default; ResizableCornerComponent or setResizable(true, true) with limits
   - Re-roll TextButton stub whose onClick calls stateManager.reRollMasterSeed() (or processor façade)
   - timerCallback empty/stub for later metering
   - paint/resized minimal layout placing the Re-roll control

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY allowed_write_paths. If PluginProcessor get/setState must call StateManager and a.3 left incomplete hooks that already include StateManager, wire only within allowed paths—do not expand into CMake or reused DSP files.
acceptance_criteria: Source/StateManager.h and Source/StateManager.cpp exist with A/B slot capture/apply/switch APIs
StateManager serializes parameterLayoutVersion in comparison/XML state
masterSeed uint64 round-trips through StateManager get/set or comparison XML restore paths
reRollMasterSeed generates a new seed using splitmix64 and non-audio-thread entropy (std::random_device) and updates stored masterSeed
Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp define editor with juce::Timer and ResizableCornerComponent or setResizable
PluginEditor contains a Re-roll button stub wired to seed re-roll
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify the eight reused DSP/GUI files
call std::random_device inside processBlock or other audio-thread code
add host-automatable momentary Re-roll parameter (GUI button + state only)
implement full GUI metering wiring or DriftDisplay

allowed: mirror shred-width StateManager A/B design extended with masterSeed
minimal editor skeleton with Re-roll button only
forbidden: full custom LookAndFeel restyle beyond stub
expose Re-roll as automatable APVTS parameter
